recognize_zh: 中倍下骨髓內淋巴聚集由大量小型、深染、圓核淋巴球組成，中央區夾雜紅血球與小血管、細胞密度略不均，邊緣與周圍造血組織交界清楚，是骨髓反應性淋巴濾泡的放大觀察。
features: Dense lymphoid aggregate composed of small lymphocytes with round, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Slightly looser central area with interspersed red cells and a small capillary
No sheets of large atypical cells; no obvious centroblasts or tingible-body macrophages resolved at this power
Aggregate edge merges with surrounding hematopoietic marrow containing erythroid and myeloid cells
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a dense lymphoid aggregate composed predominantly of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round hyperchromatic nuclei. The central area is slightly looser with interspersed red cells and small vessels; distinct germinal center cells (centroblasts, tingible-body macrophages) are not clearly resolved at this magnification. No large atypical cells or sheets of blasts are identified. Findings are suggestive of a benign lymphoid aggregate/follicle; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD3, CD10, BCL6, BCL2) would help confirm a reactive germinal center.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are typically paratrabecular with monotonous centrocytes and BCL2-positive follicle center cells.
CLL cells are CD5+/CD23+ small lymphocytes forming irregular aggregates with pale proliferation centers of prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts.
Mastocytosis lesions contain spindle mast cells with clear cytoplasm, eosinophils and fibrosis, confirmed by tryptase/CD117/CD25.
